Each result allows at most 20000 evidence characters, with 64000 evidence characters cumulatively. Evidence characters include visible source text and any pagination text; fixed message framing and accounting fields are excluded. Truncated pages are incomplete evidence, not summaries of unseen content. Measured task success requires use of both websearch and webfetch, as well as an evidence-supported answer. Cite only actual evidence obtained through the available tools. State unresolved limitations. Aim for roughly 600 words when useful; this is guidance, not a word limit. No hidden controller assistance is available.

If a legacy post-validation root_validator is retained temporarily, is skip_on_failure=False permitted and what setting is required instead? Show or describe the relevant annotation; a complete runnable model is not required.

Actually: `root_validator(pre=True)`... The guide: "root_validator(skip_on_failure=False) is no longer permitted" — you must set skip_on_failure=True (unless pre=True?). Correct: from migration docs: 

```
if you use root_validator without arguments...

```
